items.question: What is EventTick?
items.answer: A countdown and widget app for iOS and Android. Package: com.zuki.apps.eventtick.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No. Events stay on your device.

items.question: What is included for free?
items.answer: Three events, a set of countdown styles and accents, and minimal/compact widgets.

items.question: What does Premium add?
items.answer: Unlimited events and extra countdown styles, accents, and widget looks. Product ID: com.zuki.apps.eventtick.premium.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for EventTick — Countdown & Widgets.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use EventTick and related pages at zukiapps.com/eventtick.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the EventTick app and the legal pages we publish for the product.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: EventTick is designed to work on-device. We collect limited data to run the app and optional purchases.
items: Event names, dates, styles, and Premium status stored on device
Feedback and support messages you send
Purchase records handled by Apple or Google — tokens only, not full card data

section3.title: 3. How we use information
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Advertising and tracking
section4.content: EventTick does not show ads in the current build. If ads are added later, this Policy will be updated.
section4.content2: You can limit tracking in system settings.

section5.title: 5. Storage and retention
section5.content: Event data remains on device until you uninstall.
section5.content2: Ad and purchase partners retain data under their own policies.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Apple App Store and Google Play Billing may process purchase data under their policies.
section6.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing. Contact us to exercise rights.
section7.content2: EventTick is a general-audience utility. It is not directed to children under 13.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.

q1.question: How many events can I add?
q1.answer: Free includes 3 events. Premium unlocks unlimited events.

q2.question: Do widgets need an internet connection?
q2.answer: No. Countdowns run on your device.

q3.question: How do I restore Premium?
q3.answer: Use Restore purchases in Settings after reinstall. Payments are processed by Apple or Google. Product ID: com.zuki.apps.eventtick.premium.

q4.question: Where are my events stored?
q4.answer: On your device. Uninstalling the app deletes local events.
